facts.fact: Minister Amal El Fellah Seghrouchni told the House of Representatives on 1 December 2025 that the ministry's Cloud 2025-2030 roadmap, with the Cloud First Policy, will be adopted progressively as the default option in public services.

MAR.note: The Dakhla EcoDar data centre is a project, not in service.

facts.fact: The minister said on 1 December 2025 that the Cloud 2025-2030 roadmap, through the Cloud First Policy under Digital Morocco 2030, will strengthen the country's digital sovereignty.

MAR.note: Only a planned data centre is named.
